chunks: And in it that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Glorified, did not create anything except that it is within His power.
And He did not make for it a controller other than Him.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about Allah's power over creation?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this saying to affirm the doctrine of *Tawhid al-af'al* (Oneness of Divine Actions), countering the Mu'tazila and Khawarij views that attributed independent agency to created beings. This highlights the Shia theological stance that while humans possess acquired power (*kasb*), all ultimate control and efficacy remain exclusively with Allah, reinforcing the concept of divine sovereignty over all existence.
